techniques.name: Live dithering
techniques.mechanism: COMPOSITE contents are processed by the locked processing chain.
techniques.pluginSurface: Keep processing intact and use COMPOSITE as the clean drop target.

techniques.name: Pattern choice
techniques.mechanism: Toggle layers inside the CHOOSE DITHER PATTERN smart object and save it.
techniques.pluginSurface: Generate guarded steps for open, toggle, save, close, and visual proof.

techniques.name: Pattern tuning
techniques.mechanism: Adjust pattern scale, angle, opacity, or blend when the smart object exposes those controls.
techniques.pluginSurface: Treat exact controls as runtime-discovered until the smart object is inspected.

techniques.name: Background toggle
techniques.mechanism: BLACK BG and WHITE BG control the design background.
techniques.pluginSurface: When white background is active, prompt to disable multiply textures unless approved.

techniques.name: Coloring
techniques.mechanism: Paint PAINT IN MASK while the color-overlay style defines ink color.
techniques.pluginSurface: Swatch list, recolor packet, and paint-arm instructions.

techniques.name: Screen count
techniques.mechanism: Five default slots, with roughly six including white as the screen-print sweet spot.
techniques.pluginSurface: Warn before expanding beyond the practical print count.

techniques.name: Lighter shade
techniques.mechanism: Low-opacity mask painting creates thinner dither but keeps the same screen.
techniques.pluginSurface: Represent as shade strength rather than a separate ink.

techniques.name: Stacking
techniques.pluginSurface: Reorder color groups only within the colorway.

techniques.name: Paint with light
techniques.mechanism: Use image copies and Levels to map highlights or shadows into a color group.
techniques.pluginSurface: Create guarded packets for highlight or shadow color setup.

techniques.name: Neutral base
techniques.mechanism: Flood a mask with neutral gray while painting and recolor later.
techniques.pluginSurface: Offer as a reversible color-slot prep step.

techniques.name: Link color and art
techniques.mechanism: Link color group and corresponding composite element so they move together.
techniques.pluginSurface: Computer Use runbook can ask for link proof before moving.

techniques.name: Naming
techniques.mechanism: Manual naming is mandatory in the tutorial workflow.
techniques.pluginSurface: Edit packets should include intended names for layers and outputs.

techniques.name: Textures
techniques.mechanism: Worn Plastisol samples multiply over the artwork; imported textures use screen, invert, and threshold cleanup.
techniques.pluginSurface: Toggle built-in textures and keep imported texture cleanup explicit.

techniques.name: Separation
techniques.mechanism: Stamp visible on a copy, remove background, cut each ink color to a named layer, group, and save PSD/TIFF.
techniques.pluginSurface: Output checklist and later guarded automation.

techniques.name: Misregistration
techniques.mechanism: Tint black separation and add a small white inner shadow offset.
techniques.pluginSurface: One-click vintage misprint packet with direction and strength.

techniques.name: Mockup
techniques.mechanism: Place flattened preview into a layered tee mockup design group and set garment color.
techniques.pluginSurface: Export checklist with mockup destination and proof expectations.
